insights.summary: Q1 FY27 was STL's best quarter: revenue up 87% to ₹1,910 Cr, reported EBITDA of ₹397 Cr (20.8%) and record PAT of ₹197 Cr. Orders of ₹13,100 Cr, including a $1.1 billion multi-year hyperscaler deal through FY29, lifted the open order book to ₹18,618 Cr. Having hit its 20% margin target in Q1, management raised EBITDA margin guidance to 23%, expects data centre and enterprise to reach 50% of FY27 revenue, and became net cash after a ₹1,500 Cr QIP.

analyst_questions.answer: No utilisation figures; debottlenecking and upgrades to take more orders; picking orders by capacity.
Input costs (germanium, helium, polymers) rose with the war; improvement expected.
No revenue guidance; utilisation should keep improving.
About ₹500 Cr a year for three years; $100 million US connectivity plant over five years.

red_flags.text: Order book now concentrated in one $1.1 billion hyperscaler contract.
Capacity is tight; growth needs debottlenecking and capex while raw materials are scarce.
Still no revenue guidance or capacity disclosure.

EBITDA margin staying above 20% on the way to 23%
